The '''sorumi''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]]. Female sorumi, known as a doe, were tall, slender, and were considered gracious<ref name="Omen" /> and fast runners.<ref name="First Blood">{{InsiderCite|125|First Blood (short story)}}</ref>
